review_type: independent AI editorial review of eight new A2 speaking items
reviewer: Independent AI reviewer (Sonnet), separate context from the author

meaning_first.independence_note: Blind findings per item were written to content/reviews/093-review.md from the source-only packet of the original (hash fc055134...) before the full batch, starters, notes or plan assignment were opened. After the edits the packet was rebuilt from the proposed bytes; only the buurman-hond cue and the boodschappen-online panel 3 brief changed.

tone_balance.scope_note: One lightly humorous task (buurman-hond, the dog that stops at every tree) and seven ordinary ones; rounding cap for 8 items is ceil(8 x 0.15) = 2. The coordinator checks the combined A2 speaking program count.

edits.before: Kun jij zaterdag met hem wandelen, en hoe laat kom je hem halen?
edits.after: Kun jij zaterdag met Bobbie wandelen, en hoe laat kom je hem halen?
edits.reason: Heard once, the first 'hem' could be taken for Henk; the name makes the dog the object of the favour. Still one question with two parts, 33 words.

edits.before: takes milk, cheese and vegetables out of a shopping bag and puts them into an open fridge
edits.after: takes milk, cheese and vegetables out of a plastic crate on the counter and puts them into an open fridge
edits.reason: Panel 2 delivers crates; unpacking from a bag broke the picture chain (the author flagged it). The alt is unchanged and stays true.

batch_check.result: Checked 8 items, 0 questions. No failures, no warnings (no unlisted word, no compound reported).

checks.open_task_contract: pass: the prompt (or the spoken cue plus prompt) asks for every hidden criterion; counts appear in the prompt; picture-choose ends with 'Zeg ook iets over het andere plaatje.'; models 38-44 words; one null quote per sample, verbatim quotes
checks.leak_check: pass: titles, situation lines and starters give away no pictured fact; cue and prompt do not repeat each other
checks.names: Henk in two items (buurman-hond, boodschappen-online), the other names in one; no voice names or old cast; no organisation named, so no web check was needed.
checks.cast_traits: Henk, Gülsen, the repairer, Ayoub and the gift pair keep their traits verbatim across their briefs.
checks.roles: Cues use m-older and f-mature, existing roles in config/voices.json; each cue has a single speaker.

diversity.within_batch: Two of each type; eight distinct topics across werk, winkels, buurt, vrije tijd and vervoer. Mirjam and Henk both have a cue about a weekend-style favour or chat but differ in purpose.
diversity.set_assembly: kantoor-thuiswerken is close to existing alleen-samen (new job, work setting); keep them out of one set. bouwmarkt shares the 'two things he buys' operation with kassa. The dog-neighbour Henk recurs in boodschappen-online (an older man, same dog); acceptable, but do not put both in one set of four.

media_notes.audio: Two cues: Henk (m-older) and Mirjam (f-mature), different voices; promptAudio narrator. 'Bobbie' should be checked in the transcription round trip.
pictures: boodschappen-online panel 3 redrawn from the edited brief: the crate must be visible, no bag
fiets-lek: front tyre clearly flat in panel 1; repairer identical in panels 2-3
cadeau-kiezen pair: only the gift differs; kantoor-thuiswerken pair: Ayoub identical, blank laptop screens
bouwmarkt: show at least two clearly separate pots of paint; vergadering: coffee, biscuits and water visible

limitations: AI editorial review does not validate CEFR difficulty or official exam equivalence.
Level verdicts compare with existing A2 speaking items from the catalogue, not with official DUO items, which were not re-opened.
Rendered pictures and audio need their own review.

level.verdict: comparable to existing A2 video-answers (cursuskeuze, ochtenddienst): one cue with two parts plus one prompt detail; the model has no subordinate clause

meaning.situation_summary: Henk, who has a sore knee, asks the learner to walk his small dog Bobbie on Saturday and at what time the learner will fetch it; the learner answers at his door.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Agree or decline the favour, name the time and the place of the walk, as one would with a neighbour.
meaning.coherence_explanation: Reason (knee) is stated in the cue, the dog is on the still, the question follows from the reason. The dog joke ('stopt bij elke boom') is a single clause; the question works without it.
meaning.contrivance_check: Reason (knee) is stated in the cue, the dog is on the still, the question follows from the reason. The dog joke ('stopt bij elke boom') is a single clause; the question works without it.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: Spoken answer to a neighbour who stands in front of the learner; a real exchange, no invented history.
meaning.tone_reason: One clause about a dog that stops at every tree.
